references.text: Nethanel, son of Zuar, is mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Issachar, the same person who brought the offering on the second day.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, is named as the chief over the tribe of Issachar in the camp arrangement.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, led the army of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness journey.
Issachar was one of Jacob's sons, and his descendants formed the tribe that Nethanel represented.
